hotels.title: Bali Secluded Beachfront Private Pool Villas with Butler Service, In-Villa Fine Dining & Onsite Spa
hotels.description: Set along Bali’s southeast coast, Anapuri Villas offers direct access to Saba Beach and sweeping views across the Lombok Strait. All four secluded villas pair contemporary design with Balinese detailing, each with a private pool and generous indoor-outdoor living spaces. Sanur’s cafes and galleries are a short drive away, while Ubud’s temples and rice terraces sit inland for a day trip. Nearby, guests can dine on fresh seafood in Ketewel or visit the Sukawati Art Market for carved wood, textiles and local produce.
